settings.headline: Give someone
settings.subtitle: A sealed envelope with a clue inside makes a better present than anything in a box. Here's how giving a Postmark trip works. Nothing is bought on this website; we arrange everything with you by email.

settings.caption: The Azores · Wildcard · a 10th anniversary gift
settings.headline: A clue now,
settings.body:
When you give a trip, we post a printed gift envelope to you or straight to them. Inside is a card with the trip tier, a clue that's just for them and a code to start planning. They choose their own dates within 18 months and tell us what they love, and we plan it like any other Postmark trip.

You can keep the destination a surprise from yourself, too, or ask us to tell you once it's booked.

points.title: Printed and posted
points.text: Cotton paper, wax seal, in the mail within two working days.

points.title: They pick the dates
points.text: Any time in the next 18 months.

points.title: Flexible
points.text: They can move up a tier and pay the difference.

settings.headline: Four steps,
settings.subtitle: From your inquiry to their airport moment.

steps.title: Tell us about them
steps.text: Use the planner and tick "it's a gift". Tell us who it's for and anything you know about what they love.

steps.title: Agree the details
steps.text: We confirm the tier and price by email and send a secure invoice. Nothing is paid on this website.

steps.title: The envelope arrives
steps.text: We post the gift envelope, with their clue and planning code, to you or to them.

steps.title: They go
steps.text: They pick the dates and answer our questions, and open their trip envelope at the airport.

settings.headline: Start a gift inquiry
settings.subtitle: It takes five minutes, and there's no obligation until you've seen the quote.
